items.title: MetLife (MET) Stock Looks Below Fair Value While Earnings Sit Above Fair Value
items.summary: MetLife stock has nearly doubled investors' money over the past five years, yet there is a clear split in what the current price implies, with the Excess Returns intrinsic value estimate pointing to a sizeable discount while earnings-based multiples lean in the opposite direction. Over the past five years, MetLife has delivered a 91.4% total return, which puts more pressure on today's valuation to be supported by future cash flows rather than past price gains.
